label: prf:topological-mass-categorical
title: Categorical proof of the topological decomposition of mass
html:
Proof. Categorical proof of the topological decomposition of mass

Proof. We assemble the decomposition from three lemmas. By (eigenspace decomposition), the descent involution gives an orthogonal Frobenius-norm split

  \mathfrak{m}(\varrho)
  =
  \bigl\lVert \mathrm{tr}(\hat{\tau}_n(\alpha)) \bigr\rVert
  +
  \bigl\lVert \mathrm{tr}(\alpha - \hat{\tau}_n(\alpha)) \bigr\rVert,

where \alpha = (\int_A \otimes \mathrm{id}) \circ \Delta \circ \varrho. By (descended term equals base mass), the first summand is \mathfrak{m}(\varrho_0). By (transient terms localise to blow-ups), the second summand decomposes as \sum_{i=1}^{N} \mathrm{tr}_{\mathrm{trans}}(\varrho, p_i). Combining yields the claimed decomposition. \square
